target.description: the plan section or task the critique lands on, quoted or named precisely

critique.description: the concrete gap, violation, contradiction, or unjustified complexity — with the failure it causes

suggestion.description: the concrete improvement that resolves it, or null if the right fix is genuinely open

items.// required-note: Same rule as qc-findings-schema.json: OpenAI's structured-output API rejects any schema whose `required` omits a key present in `properties` — optionality is expressed with nullable types, never by omission from `required`.
